mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ITINERARY_DAY ( itinerary_id, sheet_id, day_order, day_date, title, source_day_id ) VALUES ( #{itineraryId}, #{sheetId}, #{dayOrder}, #{dayDate}, #{title}, #{sourceDayId} )
mapper.select: SELECT day_id, itinerary_id, sheet_id, day_order, day_date, title, source_day_id, created_at FROM TB_ITINERARY_DAY WHERE itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} ORDER BY day_order ASC
